description: This source file implements C++ functions providing TPM (Trusted Platform Module) related functionalities, including HMAC computation and logging, used as part of secure environment management in Android. It interacts with external TPM resource management classes and uses Android base logging facilities.

methods.name: uint32_t tpm_hmac(void * trm,const uint8_t * data,uint32_t data_len,uint8_t * tag,uint32_t tag_len)
methods.description: Computes an HMAC using the provided TPM resource manager context, data, and outputs it into the buffer, with error handling for null pointers and size mismatches.

methods.name: void secure_env_log(const char * file,unsigned int line,int severity,const char * tag,const char * msg)
methods.description: Logs a message with specified severity level, file, line, and tag, mapping integer severity to Android's LogSeverity enumeration.

ctags.signature: (const char * file,unsigned int line,int severity,const char * tag,const char * msg)
